insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd.

room_rent.note: Policy wording does not cap room rent; charges are reimbursable as charged by hospital, but no explicit cap or category mentioned in the wording

icu.note: ICU charges are listed as reimbursable but no specific cap or limit is mentioned

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: No explicit disease-wise or procedure sub-limits stated in the wording; Specified Treatments (cataract, dialysis, etc.) are listed but no monetary caps given

deductible.note: A deductible is referenced as applicable per claim and stated in Part a of the Schedule, but the actual rupee amount is not disclosed in the policy wording

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; 90-day waiting for hypertension, diabetes, cardiac conditions

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from policy inception; no optional reduction mentioned

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract, hernia, hydrocele, arthritis, joint replacements, stones, piles, sinusitis, skin tumours, dialysis, tonsils, gastric ulcers, deviated nasal septum, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded under Excl18; only ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement benefit mentioned; limit of indemnity is reinstated only if a claim is rejected

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses are defined and covered but the number of days is not stated in the wording

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses are defined and covered but the number of days is not stated in the wording

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered for procedures requiring less than 24 hours due to technological advancement; specific treatments listed

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is explicitly excluded under specific exclusion (xxii)

ayush.note: AYUSH treatments, AYUSH hospitals and AYUSH day care centres are defined and included in the policy scope

organ_donor.note: Costs of donor screening or treatment including surgery to remove organs from a donor are explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges are explicitly excluded under specific exclusion (xix)

modern_treatments.note: No mention of modern/robotic treatments in the policy wording

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables (gloves, syringes, etc.) explicitly excluded per IRDAI non-payables list

global_cover.note: Cover is restricted to India; treatment outside geographical scope is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: No moratorium period explicitly stated in the policy wording

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Free look period is referenced in the cancellation clause but the number of days is not stated

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI norms; credits for PED and specific waiting periods transferable

notable_exclusions: Ambulance charges, domiciliary hospitalisation, organ donor costs, sleep disorders/apnoea, dental (non-accident), cochlear implants (non-accident), OPD treatment
